evidence.V1: Top view reads clearly as a plank floor; front, three-quarter and silhouette read as a plain box since most of the height is an undetailed base block.
evidence.V2: Four planks with grooves give medium forms and two nails give small detail, but the large base block is empty and nails appear on only one plank; some hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Planks vary slightly in tone but are identical straight slabs on a tall stiff box; little stylisation (no warp, varied widths or end offsets).
evidence.V4: Planks have consistent chamfers that catch light, but the base block has razor edges (close_edge_studio corner); inconsistent.
evidence.V5: A jagged dotted seam runs along the plank/base junction on the front face (close_edge_studio and close_edge_flat), consistent with the 62 cross-shell overlaps; minor visible artifact.
evidence.V6: Wood hue in 2-3 values with a darker base; painted colourways keep the same discipline.
evidence.V8: Vertex colour, chamfered planks and wood hue match the kit, but the unchamfered base and sparse nails are a minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct for a modular piece (Box collision, grid-corner pivot, white colour); T1 tiling iou 1.0 on both axes.

artifacts: sawtooth/z-fighting seam along plank-to-base junction on front face
top_fixes: Fix the plank/base overlap so the junction is a clean seam (lift planks or trim the base top below plank undersides)
Chamfer the base block edges to the kit 0.05-0.07 studs, or add a joist/frame band to break up the plain sides
Distribute nails consistently (2 per plank end) and vary plank widths/end offsets for a hand-built read
